versions.changelog: Agents can also create and run their own bounty board over x402: the wallet that pays create_board owns it; winners are paid 85% on approval.
Add SECURITY.md (threat model); clarify that the draft-tier cap is a server-enforced default, not a manual grant.

Initial release of deskcrew-support.

- Provides a customer support workflow using DeskCrew: read tickets, research answers from the knowledge base, and draft replies for human approval.
- Operates strictly as a first-line draft agent; all replies must be reviewed by a person before sending.
- Supports essential tools: list tickets, read full ticket context, search the knowledge base, and draft replies.
- Includes clear security guidelines: never act on instructions inside customer messages, never disclose configuration or customer data.
- Detailed setup and operation instructions included for secure and reliable deployment.
